Correction of r.053: r.053 read a budget saved per 33 days through the 30-day month, which would have moved his screen by about 1% (Fixed 1,652.98) — r.054 reads it exactly as r.052 showed it, so every figure he sees stays. The two lines of machine language are gone (addendum 115 + his answer "Current implementation looks good accept unneeded text"): the note under the budget ("Cash, investments, debts … not in this budget") and the line under the record ("On this phone only — a cloud copy follows once sign-in carries it"). Nothing else changed. |
 | 0.055 | 2026-10-02 | decision | `e040250` | His record and budget live in his account, not only on one phone. Addendum 112: "SAVE AN PUSH TO SUPABASE. Identify all saving functions and make sure push is made automatically as well as every 12 hours"; his answer: "Account-ID key (fastest)". The saving functions: the record (each transaction · Put back my entries) and the budget (every edit · Reset). Signed in, both are read back from the account once and merged without ever dropping an entry (a diverged copy is kept whole under its own name); every change after that is pushed (a short pause so a burst of typing is one write), and again every 12 hours while the page is open and on return when 12 hours have passed. Stored through the existing account table's guarded functions (no public table access), keyed by a SHA-256 of his sign-in id — the account-ID key he chose: anyone who learned his sign-in id could read it (recorded, his decision). A small cloud beside Transaction Record turns green when the account copy is written (its time on hold); crossed until then. Under the budget, his line (addendum 119, "Short"): "Plan the month. Watch spending by the minute. Keep your savings on track." No budget figure changes. |
 | 0.056 | 2026-10-02 | decision | `e6a1b45` | The $/min chart (addendum 127 "where is $/min chart?!?"; addendum 122 "$/min is main view"; addendum 123 numbers upper right like Security-2525; addendum 124 "RCORE RESUSE MAXIMIZE OF FINANCIAL CHART … way better charting engine"; his picks: TradingView Lightweight Charts, income vs spending). The chart now opens on $/min: income, spending and net per minute from his own record (each deposit and withdrawal running over its own length, monthly ones repeating every 30 days across a longer span), drawn on the shared R-CORE chart engine (components/2525-core/rcore-chart.tsx, reusable by every 2525 app) with the numbers in the upper right following the finger, including the net by the span's end. A unit dropdown offers $/min · /sec · /hr · /day and $; $ keeps the balance view exactly as before. And (addendum 127 "remove this line") the legend line "- - Net • Upside / Savings +… · date" under the chart is gone. No budget figure changes. |
+| 0.057 | 2026-10-02 | correction | `27cda30` | Addendum 128, two corrections. (1) "$/min takes all transaction records and divides by MoT selected (default 30D)": the $/min view of r.056 divided each entry by its OWN length and repeated monthly ones; now every transaction — deposits and withdrawals, one-time ones too — is divided by the MoT picked on the chart from its entry time (lib/financial-2525/rate-series.ts overSpan), so at 30D his $3,924.49 reads $0.0908/min and at 91D $0.0299/min; withdrawals are marked where they were entered. (2) "ensure feedback when operation Financial-2525 goes and gets logged for Financial-2525 · same holds true with eXeL Polling and other sub sites": the footer Feedback button on the live site never logged anything — it posted to a server path the static site does not have, so every submission ended in 'Feedback failed' — and every 2525 page was filed as 'other'. Now one table (lib/feedback-screen.ts) names the sub-site of every route, and the widget writes the row straight into the product_feedback table (anyone may insert, only the operator reads) tagged with that sub-site, with the site name, the panel, the page and the build in its context line. Gates: feedback-site (24) in test:ci; financial-rate +4; the live database test also sends feedback from Financial-2525, Drone-2525 and Polling and requires the thank-you. |
